title: Provision of NSAG information to lower layers

entities.name: NSAG information
entities.description: Contains a list of NSAG IDs each associated with S-NSSAIs from configured NSSAI, an NSAG area with TAIs, and a priority value. Used for NSAG-aware cell reselection.

entities.name: NSAG ID
entities.description: Identifier for a Network Slice Assistance Group, associated with specific S-NSSAIs and valid in a defined NSAG area.

entities.name: List of S-NSSAIs
entities.description: S-NSSAIs included in the configured NSSAI, associated with an NSAG ID.

entities.name: NSAG area
entities.description: Area defined by a list of TAIs where the mapping between S-NSSAIs and NSAG ID is valid.

entities.name: Priority value
entities.description: Value associated with each NSAG ID in the NSAG information, indicating priority for NSAG-aware operations.

entities.name: UE NAS layer
entities.description: Non-Access Stratum layer in the UE responsible for managing NAS procedures and providing NSAG information to lower layers.

entities.name: Lower layers
entities.description: Protocol layers below NAS in the UE, such as AS layers, which receive NSAG information for NSAG-aware cell reselection.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: Network Slice Selection Assistance Information allowed for the UE, provided to lower layers along with NSAG information.

entities.name: Requested NSSAI
entities.description: Network Slice Selection Assistance Information requested by the UE, provided to lower layers along with NSAG information.

relations.description: NSAG information includes a list of NSAG IDs.
Each NSAG ID is associated with a list of S-NSSAIs from the configured NSSAI.
Each NSAG ID is associated with an NSAG area defined by TAIs.
Each NSAG ID has an associated priority value in the NSAG information.
UE NAS layer provides the most recent NSAG information to lower layers when available.
UE provides allowed NSSAI to lower layers along with NSAG information for NSAG-aware cell reselection.
UE provides requested NSSAI to lower layers along with NSAG information for NSAG-aware cell reselection.
